versions.changelog:
Initial release of 明洞丹雅皮肤科预约助手 (Dana Clinic Booking).

- Provides booking services for 明洞丹雅皮肤科 in Seoul, including skin treatment and cosmetic procedures.
- Supports viewing booking guides, opening clinic info, submitting reservations, consulting customer service, price inquiries, and app downloads.
- No external dependencies; uses only Node.js core modules.
- Multi-language support (Chinese and English).
- Modular design with hospital data, booking templates, and localization files.
